explanation: Theorem 1's own setup defines a DKEP boundary piece as a hereditary C*-subalgebra invariant under the full left and right M-actions. The reviewer says this is the wrong object in the DKEP framework: boundary pieces are only required to be invariant under a specified ultraweakly dense C*-subalgebra, so the flaw is already in Theorem 1's statement/hypotheses.
